standaloneWorker.systemToolList:
- case_read: Read a project file. Large results require explicit line pagination.
- case_list: List one directory, excluding agent settings and CASE state. No recursive dumping.
- case_write: Write a complete UTF-8 file inside the packet writeScope. Cannot change agent settings or CASE records.
- case_result: Finish this session by supplying the requested result object exactly once, after all other tools. Does not execute or authorize CASE actions. No further tools may run afterward.

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
